title: Reciprocity in Machine Learning
reasoning: The paper discusses reciprocity as a social norm and draws on sociological and philosophical literature (e.g., Rawls and Cicero) for motivation. However, the core of the work is the proposal and technical measurement of a 'reciprocity' metric based on training data influence in recommender and healthcare systems, rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethical systems.
